questions.question: In a prophet's vision, a fourth king of Persia, richer than all the others, stirs up everyone against which kingdom?
In a vision of the kings of the South and North, how does a despicable person get the kingdom?

answers.text: He seizes it by intrigue in a time of peace
He wins it in a great battle at sea
The king of the South hands it to him

questions.question: In a vision, the king of the North flatters those who violate the covenant. What will the people who know their God do?
In a vision of the kings of the South and North, why will some of the wise fall?

answers.text: So they may be refined and purified
So their enemies may be put to shame
So the city may be spared
